scope: Local Linux checkpoint.48 ordinary room fanout processes and12 private/reconnect guards; eight exploratory baseline cases. Profiles and four allocator diagnostics run separately. Gated membership transitions are between verified windows, not continuous concurrent membership during a suspended route. Source attribution in older private raw traces is contextual; their master comparison preserves the actual frozen sources, and the corrected harness has a separate verified source check. Runtime sources match the browser acceptance revision. Hosted deployment and GitHub CI execution are not claimed. Goal remains active.

profiles.scope: Two separate eight-second cycles:u499Hz DWARF8192 one-worker diagnostics,512 readers,one-frame windows,one temporary membership cycle every2 windows, no private traffic. All bodies,counters,Close/EOF and cleanup still verify. Excluded from ordinary timing. Sampled self symbols are not wall-time/CPU savings and no off-CPU waiting is measured. Full normalized flat reports retain the0.1% cutoff; raw captures remain local and ignored for size.

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
bench = root / 'docs/benchmarks'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda name: json.loads((bench / f'2026-10-16-room-churn-{name}.json').read_text())
desc = lambda path: {'path': str(Path(path).relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(path)}
meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/room-churn-reuse-candidate.json').read_text())
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
assert subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', meta['source_revision'], 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=root).returncode == 0
for name, digest in meta['sources'].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == digest
for name, digest in meta['binaries'].items():
    assert sha(root / meta['directory'] / name) == sha(root / 'target/release' / name) == digest

def empty(metrics):
    for key in ['war_connections', 'war_sessions', 'war_queued_bytes', 'war_variable_bytes',
                'war_output_queue_capacity_bytes', 'war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes']:
        assert int(metrics[key]) == 0, (key, metrics[key])
    assert int(metrics['war_channels']) == 1

def trace_ok(data, binary, diagnostic=False):
    assert data['passed'] and data['server_sha256'] == binary and data['profile_diagnostic'] == diagnostic
    assert data['server_exit_code'] == data['client_exit_code'] == 0 and not data['server_forced_kill']
    assert [event['event'] for event in data['events']] == ['ready', 'measured', 'done']
    for event in data['events']:
        assert 'exact_counter_checks' in event
        assert event['metrics']['war_routing_copied_bytes_total'] == 0
        assert event['metrics']['war_setup_errors_total'] == event['metrics']['war_accept_errors_total'] == 0
    empty(data['events'][-1]['metrics'])

comparison = read('reuse-comparison')
assert comparison['passed'] and len(comparison['cases']) == 48
assert comparison['candidate']['sources'] == meta['sources']
assert comparison['variants']['selected']['sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert comparison['variants']['before']['sha256'] == meta['baseline_sha256']
assert comparison['client']['sha256'] == meta['helper']['client_sha256']
overlap = {}
for key, old in comparison['medians'].items():
    if key.endswith('/before'):
        new = comparison['medians'][key[:-6] + 'selected']
        a, b = old['ranges']['fanout'], new['ranges']['fanout']
        overlap[key.split('/')[0]] = max(a[0], b[0]) <= min(a[1], b[1])
assert sum(overlap.values()) == 7 and not overlap['w1-r512-b1-c0']
for row in comparison['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); trace_ok(data, comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'])
    assert data['client_sha256'] == meta['helper']['client_sha256']
    assert data['args']['pairs'] == 0 and data['args']['workers'] == row['workers']
guard = read('routing-guard'); assert guard['passed'] and len(guard['cases']) == 12
assert 'source_attribution_note' in guard
for row in guard['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['trace_sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); trace_ok(data, guard['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'])
    assert data['client_sha256'] == guard['client']['sha256']
for name, digest in guard['client']['source_hashes'].items():
    assert sha(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe' / name) == digest
source = read('source-check'); trace_ok(source, meta['binaries']['war-relay'])
assert source['client_source_root'] == str(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe')
assert source['client_sources_sha256'] == guard['client']['source_hashes']
assert source['client_source_sha256'] != sha(root / 'examples/inspection.rs')
assert source['runner_sha256'] == sha(root / 'scripts/inspection.py')
baseline = read('baseline'); assert baseline['passed'] and len(baseline['cases']) == 8
for row in baseline['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256']
    trace_ok(json.loads(path.read_text()), meta['baseline_sha256'])
smoke = read('smoke'); trace_ok(smoke, meta['baseline_sha256'])
memory = read('memory'); assert memory['passed'] and len(memory['cases']) == 4 and len(memory['captures']) == 12
for row in memory['cases']:
    path = root / row['trace']; assert sha(path) == row['sha256']
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()); trace_ok(data, comparison['variants'][row['kind']]['sha256'], True)
    if row['mode'] == 'churn':
        assert data['mixed']['counts']['sent_messages'] == row['work_units']
for capture in memory['captures']:
    assert sha(root / capture['path']) == capture['sha256']
old, new = [case for case in memory['cases'] if case['mode'] == 'churn']
assert new['allocation_per_work_unit']['allocated_bytes'] < old['allocation_per_work_unit']['allocated_bytes'] * .74
assert all(old['phases']['done'][key] == new['phases']['done'][key] for key in ['live_objects', 'live_bytes'])
stable = [case for case in memory['cases'] if case['mode'] == 'stable']
assert stable[0]['allocation_delta'] == stable[1]['allocation_delta'] == {'allocated_objects': 52, 'allocated_bytes': 66600}
profiles = read('profiles'); assert profiles['passed'] and [case['samples'] for case in profiles['cases']] == [3369, 3349]
for case in profiles['cases']:
    for name in ['trace', 'raw_data', 'raw_report', 'published_report']:
        assert sha(root / case[name]['path']) == case[name]['sha256']
    assert case['lost'] == 0
    trace_ok(json.loads((root / case['trace']['path']).read_text()), case['server_sha256'], True)
upper = read('reuse-upper-bound'); trace_ok(upper, meta['binaries']['war-relay'])
assert upper['args']['fanout_readers'] == 1024 and upper['mixed']['fanout_membership']['verified'] > 0
ci = read('ci'); trace_ok(ci, sha(root / 'target/debug/war-relay'))
assert ci['args']['workers'] == 2 and not ci['args']['server_cpus'] and not ci['args']['client_cpus']
stress = read('reuse-stability'); assert stress['passed'] and len(stress['cases']) == 4
assert stress['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
for case in stress['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['server_exit_code'] == case['exit_code'] == 0 and not case['server_forced_kill']
    assert case['cleaned_up'] and case['counts_match'] and case['pressure_valid']; empty(case['final']['metrics'])
accept, setup = read('reuse-accept'), read('reuse-setup')
assert accept['passed'] and len(accept['cases']) == 3 and accept['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert accept['bridge_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-legacy-bridge']
for case in accept['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['pressure']['fd_count'] == 64 and all(code == 0 for code in case['process_exit_codes'])
assert setup['passed'] and setup['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay'] and len(setup['cases']) == 4
for case in setup['cases']:
    assert case['passed'] and case['process_exit_code'] == 0 and len(case['injected_calls']) == 3
    assert all(wave['slot_held_until_descriptor_close'] for wave in case['waves'])
reference, api, browser = read('reuse-reference'), read('reuse-api'), read('reuse-browser')
assert reference['passed'] and reference['common_cases'] == 48
assert reference['upstream_commit'] == '881c8daaf2cf05adea8f522b28cf372e8f82d4e9'
assert len(reference['results']['cpp']['intentional_differences']) == len(reference['results']['rust']['intentional_differences']) == 8
for role, name in [('native', 'war-relay'), ('bridge', 'war-legacy-bridge')]:
    assert reference[role]['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name] and reference[role]['exit_code'] == 0
    live = browser['runtime'][role]
    assert sha(f'/proc/{live["pid"]}/exe') == live['sha256'] == meta['binaries'][name]
assert api['passed'] and len(api['checks']) == 4 and api['server_exit_code'] == 0; empty(api['final_metrics'])
assert api['server_sha256'] == meta['binaries']['war-relay']
assert [row['status'] for row in api['manual_admission_transitions']] == [401, 204, 200, 503, 200, 401, 204, 200]
assert browser['passed'] and len(browser['browser']['checks']) == 7 and not browser['browser']['errors']
assert browser['worker_listener_sockets'] == 4 and all(status == 200 for status in browser['health'].values()); empty(browser['metrics'])
assert subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', browser['source_revision'], 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=root).returncode == 0
assert 'Total messages: 0 (Errors: 0, Warnings: 0)' in (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-reuse-browser-console.txt').read_text()

tests = (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-cache-tests.log').read_text()
suites = [int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', tests) if int(value)]
assert suites == [58, 13, 3, 3, 52, 2, 3] and sum(suites) == 134
clippy = (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-cache-clippy.log').read_text()
release = (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-cache-release.log').read_text()
js = (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-reuse-js.log').read_text()
assert 'Finished' in clippy and 'warning:' not in clippy and 'Finished' in release
assert 'pass 6' in js and 'pass 1' in js and 'fail 0' in js
before = (root / 'artifacts/room-churn-cache-before.log').read_text(); assert '2 failed' in before and 'an uncaptured view must survive' in before
checks = {'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'],
          'rust': {'command': ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '--all-targets'], 'passed': 134, 'suites': suites, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': tests},
          'clippy': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': clippy}, 'release': {'exit_code': 0, 'output': release},
          'javascript': {'passed': 7, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': js}, 'before_reuse_invariants': {'expected_exit_code': 101, 'output': before}, 'small_checks': []}
for command in [['cargo', 'fmt', '--check'], ['python3', '-m', 'py_compile', 'scripts/inspection.py'], ['python3', 'scripts/check-vendor.py']]:
    done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True); assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
    checks['small_checks'].append({'command': command, 'exit_code': 0, 'output': done.stdout + done.stderr})
(bench / '2026-10-16-room-churn-reuse-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + '\n')
tracked = lambda *paths: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', *paths], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
runtime = tracked('src', 'vendor', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
helpers = tracked('scripts', 'examples', 'tests', 'clients/js', '.github/workflows/rust.yml')
extra = [root / 'artifacts' / name for name in ['room-churn-baseline.py', 'room-churn-reuse-study.py', 'room-churn-routing-guard.py',
    'room-churn-memory.py', 'room-churn-reuse-stability.py', 'room-churn-reuse-api.py', 'refresh-room-churn-reuse-runtime.py',
    'record-room-churn-reuse-browser.py', 'record-room-churn-reuse-checkpoint.py', 'paging-accept.mjs']]
evidence = [desc(path) for path in sorted(bench.glob('2026-10-16-room-churn-*.json')) if path.name != '2026-10-16-room-churn-reuse-build.json']
record = {'passed': True, 'source_revision': revision, 'runtime_implementation_revision': meta['source_revision'],
          'helper_source_revision': meta['helper']['source_revision'], 'candidate': meta, 'platform': platform.platform(),
          'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
          'scope': 'Local Linux checkpoint.48 ordinary room fanout processes and12 private/reconnect guards; eight exploratory baseline cases. Profiles and four allocator diagnostics run separately. Metadata allocation reduction is retained; no general throughput/CPU gain or production capacity claim. Gated membership transitions are between verified windows, not continuous concurrent membership during a suspended route. Source attribution in older private raw traces is contextual; their master comparison preserves the actual frozen sources, and the corrected harness has a separate verified source check. Runtime sources match the browser acceptance revision. Hosted deployment and GitHub CI execution are not claimed. Goal remains active.',
          'runtime_sources': [desc(root / name) for name in runtime],
          'helpers_and_tests': [desc(root / name) for name in helpers] + [desc(path) for path in extra],
          'frozen_runtime': [desc(root / meta['directory'] / name) for name in meta['binaries']],
          'clients': [desc(root / meta['helper']['directory'] / 'inspection'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/fanout-probe/inspection'), desc(root / 'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress')],
          'frozen_client_sources': {name: sha(root / meta['helper']['directory'] / name) for name in ['examples/inspection.rs', 'examples/inspection/fanout.rs']},
          'evidence': evidence, 'fanout_range_overlap': overlap, 'profiles': profiles, 'heap_captures': memory['captures'],
          'browser_screenshot': browser['screenshot'], 'browser_assets': browser['browser_assets'],
          'manual_services': json.loads((root / 'artifacts/reactor-manual-services.json').read_text()),
          'collector_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
(bench / '2026-10-16-room-churn-reuse-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'source': revision, 'runtime': meta['source_revision'], 'rust': 134,
                  'ordinary_comparison_cases': 60, 'runtime_sources': len(runtime), 'helpers_and_tests': len(record['helpers_and_tests']), 'evidence': len(evidence)}))
